description: [1/4] AIKit integration: attach project, seed .aikit memory, ledger plan and ADRs

impact_assessment.benefits: Own git repo plus .aikit memory, gated delivery, explicit decisions, and a cold-start path for future work.

head: cd326accc92df2390a58b0ba9b72748a6a268938

description: [1/5] Store integrity: corrupt-line error model, strict base64, parse-before-write, directory fsync

impact_assessment.why: Stage-2 verification confirmed 14 real gaps in the shipped Postbox; the highest-impact ones let malformed input crash server threads and turn a corrupt line into an orphan append.
impact_assessment.benefits: A corrupt inbox produces a clear error instead of a traceback, and state survives power loss after file creation or atomic replacement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: F09 moves /__clear off GET, so callers and README must change together; dependency: stdlib-only, no new packages; concurrency: parse-before-write must stay inside the existing lock or a trim could race an append; state: directory fsync must degrade safely on platforms without it.
impact_assessment.mitigation: One ADR and README table per contract change; raw-socket and direct-call failing-first tests for every branch; keep all store mutations under the existing lock; guard directory fsync with a platform-safe fallback; finish with check --strict.

description: Fix: drain oversized bodies before answering 413 to avoid WinError 10053 client abort; 3 consecutive green runs, 4/4 gates passed
[1/1] Fix 413 client-abort race in the HTTP handler

impact_assessment.why: Strict delivery exposed an intermittent WinError 10053: the handler closed the socket before the client finished sending an oversized body.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deterministic 413 responses and a green strict gate across repeated runs.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, the 413 status is unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: draining must stay bounded so a large body cannot pin a thread; state: no store change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Read at most 16 MiB of the declared body before answering, and verify with three consecutive full-suite runs.

description: [1/4] Secret hygiene: redact sensitive headers and query keys at capture, skip them on replay

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed Authorization, Cookie and token query values written verbatim into the inbox file, turning a local debugging tool into a plaintext secret store.
impact_assessment.benefits: Captured payloads stay useful for debugging while credentials are not persisted or replayed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: redaction changes stored records and replay payloads, so ADR-005 and README must ship together; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: redaction is pure and runs before the store lock; state: no format change, only field values.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Centralise redaction in a pure function with known-answer tests; filter redacted headers on replay; document the behaviour before commit; run the full gate.

description: [1/4] Decode chunked request bodies with bounded reads and size limits

impact_assessment.why: A verified probe shows chunked POSTs are rejected with 400, so a sender using Transfer-Encoding: chunked cannot be captured at all.
impact_assessment.benefits: Postbox captures bodies from standard HTTP clients that stream without Content-Length.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: chunked changes from 400 to accepted, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: the decoder runs before the store lock and cannot block it; state: a malformed stream must never produce a partial record.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bound every readline, cap the accumulated body at max_body, return 400/413 before constructing a record, and use raw-socket known-answer tests.

description: [1/5] Targeted delete by id with the existing ambiguity guard

impact_assessment.why: There is no way to remove one captured request; clear wipes the whole inbox, which is too coarse for a noisy webhook stream.
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can discard a single noisy capture without losing the rest of the evidence.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new command only; dependency: none; concurrency: delete must hold the same store lock as append and trim; state: a partial delete must not corrupt the JSONL file.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Implement delete as an atomic rewrite under the existing lock, reuse find() ambiguity detection, and add failing-first tests for not-found, ambiguous and successful removal.

description: [1/4] Fix InboxStore.extend data loss when no retention cap is set

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed extend() into a non-empty inbox replaces all existing records, so importing a snapshot silently destroys prior captures.
impact_assessment.benefits: Batch appends and imports preserve existing state; no data loss.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, this restores intended behaviour; dependency: none; concurrency: decode and rewrite stay under the existing lock; state: a corrupt inbox still fails before any write.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Always decode existing records inside extend(), keep trimming only when max_requests is set, and add failing-first tests for extend and import into non-empty inboxes.

head: 4fde76102f41bf64c50f606d6c644de96dd5f434

description: [1/4] Clear endpoint safety: only POST/DELETE clear, all other methods 405, drain request body

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed HEAD /__clear wipes the inbox, defeating the documented prefetch protection, and POST /__clear with a body aborts the client with WinError 10053.
impact_assessment.benefits: Read-only probes can no longer destroy captures, and clients sending a body get a stable response.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HEAD/OPTIONS/CONNECT/TRACE on clear change from destructive to 405, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: an oversized body is drained only up to a bound.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use an explicit allowed-method set, drain a bounded prefix before answering, and add raw-socket failing-first tests for every method plus a body-bearing POST.

description: [1/2] Reject truncated request bodies instead of storing partial payloads

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a client declaring 100 bytes but sending 3 gets 200 and a truncated body stored as if complete, corrupting any later replay or analysis.
impact_assessment.benefits: Captures are guaranteed to match the declared body length; incomplete webhooks are refused loudly.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: malformed clients now get 400 instead of 200; dependency: none; concurrency: check occurs before the store write; state: no partial record can be persisted.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compare received bytes with Content-Length before constructing the record, add a raw-socket failing-first test, and document the response in README and ADR-012.

head: ff2bb51f90a0f4bb5683ce5adbddbb9f77c47ceb

description: [1/2] Reject malformed received_at values at record construction

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a bad timestamp is stored and imported, then one such record makes every time-filtered list fail with a misleading generic error.
impact_assessment.benefits: Inbox records always carry parseable timestamps, so time filtering cannot be broken by a single bad capture or snapshot.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshots or records with invalid timestamps are now refused, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: stdlib datetime only; concurrency: none; state: validation occurs before any write.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Parse in __post_init__ with a Z-tolerant fromisoformat, raise CorruptInboxError, and add failing-first tests for construction and import.

head: b77e53e52b0e20b83237f4e5030f9e828c4d7c39

description: [1/2] Ignore OS-level client disconnects when writing HTTP responses

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a normal client disconnect before reading the response produces a full ConnectionAbortedError traceback while the capture itself succeeds.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clean operator console; no confusing stack traces for routine disconnects.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, the HTTP status is unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: per-thread write path only; state: capture is persisted before the response is written.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Catch OSError around wfile.write with a documented hygiene allowance, and use a mocked wfile failing-first test.
